tools.name: search_makers
tools.description: Find independent makers on The Spool List (3D printing, cosplay, miniatures, CNC, laser, woodworking, textiles, metalwork and more) by skill, material, name or shop. Optionally narrow to a country or city. Returns public shop details: name, handle, city and country the maker chose to show, jobs comp

tools.name: get_maker_profile
tools.description: Get a maker's public profile by handle: display name, location shown, tier, verification and trust badges, stats, whether they take design jobs, and links to their shop.

tools.name: browse_open_jobs
tools.description: List current open jobs that buyers have posted and makers can quote on: title, country, budget and when it was posted. Buyer identities and full briefs are not shown; makers sign up free to see details and quote.

tools.name: search_shop_items
tools.description: Search ready-made items makers sell in The Spool List shop (the Forge) — prints, props, miniatures, parts and more. Returns title, price, maker and a link to the item page.

tools.name: search_design_library
tools.description: Search The Spool List design library of 3D-printable and fabrication designs. Returns title, designer, licence, price (if any), access ("download" for files The Spool List hosts, "view_only" for third-party models such as Sketchfab that can be viewed but not downloaded here) and a link to the design

tools.name: find_local_services
tools.description: Find local service businesses listed on The Spool List in or near a city — for example finishing, welding and fabrication, design and CAD, packing and shipping, electronics repair or architecture. Returns business name, category, area and a listing link; contact details stay on the listing page.

tools.name: estimate_job_cost
tools.description: Ballpark price range for a fabrication job from The Spool List rate cards (hourly rate by discipline, complexity, materials, setup and quantity). It is an indicative range, not a quote — makers set their own prices.

tools.name: create_job_request_link
tools.description: Turn a description of something the user wants made into a pre-filled job post link on The Spool List. Nothing is posted: the user opens the link, reviews the brief, adds photos or files and posts it (free for buyers) to get quotes from makers.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Reference lists for the other tools: job categories for create_job_request_link, estimate disciplines with base hourly rates for estimate_job_cost, the total number of live shop items, and shop markets with the items tagged into each.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_job_request_link · Private data: search_design_library, find_local_services, create_job_request_link · Public sink: create_job_request_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_job_request_link · Private data: search_design_library, find_local_services, create_job_request_link · Public sink: create_job_request_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
